Q1_is_a_per_source_session_owner_require.what_the_current_broker_scope_actually_i: SourceAccessBroker is instantiated INSIDE _decode and the resulting incidence holds it alive for later iteration via a caller-owned close lifecycle. Its natural scope is therefore ONE _decode() call.
what_it_owns_well: the operation budget for that one decode
aggregate accounting for that one decode
Q1_is_a_per_source_session_owner_require.the_gap: nothing binds ONE BOUND SOURCE ENTRY to exactly one governed lifecycle ACROSS decodes. Verified empirically: two successive decode_sav() calls on the same path each built their own broker, each with its own budget, and BOTH succeeded with no refusal. Aggregate across the two: path_opens=2, hash_passes=2, metadata_reads=2.
why_that_matters_against_the_frozen_law: SRC27 requires expected_full_route_passes=1 with max=1 and states that 'a second pass is not a retry; it is a separate run requiring new HQ-bound authority'. Two decodes means two full Route-B passes with no refusal.
SRC02/SRC06/SRC14 require expected_selected_reads=1. A second decode performs a second selected read.
per-source expectations cannot be enforced by a per-decode budget, because two per-decode budgets of 1 each sum to 2 at the source entry.
Q1_is_a_per_source_session_owner_require.conclusion: GOV-SCOPE-001 is real. The correct layer for the missing owner is ABOVE _decode, not inside the broker: the broker is correctly decode-scoped and should not be changed to carry cross-decode state itself.
Q1_is_a_per_source_session_owner_require.not_a_broker_defect: this is a MISSING OWNER, not a wrong implementation. The accepted broker mechanics are unchanged by this finding.

Q2_lifecycle_boundary_for_exactness.required_boundary: ONE bound source ENTRY of the warrant's execution surface - i.e. one row of the per-source warrant table, identified by (source_key, canonical_sha256, format, operation plan) - not one _decode() call.
Q2_lifecycle_boundary_for_exactness.why: only at the source-entry boundary can path opens, existence checks, metadata reads, decoder invocations, selected/full reads and retries be aggregated and compared against the frozen PER-SOURCE expectations. At the _decode boundary each call looks individually compliant while the aggregate is not.
Q2_lifecycle_boundary_for_exactness.operations_already_exact_today: all of the above EXCEPT decoder invocations are counted within one decode, and are exact for that decode; the deficit is aggregation across decodes plus the missing decoder-entry account.

Q4_header_prefix_admission.answer: SRC26 IS THE ONLY SOURCE THAT ADMITS A HEADER-PREFIX READ
Q4_header_prefix_admission.evidence: SRC26 is the only source carrying a frozen expected_header_prefix_bytes (176) and the only class named BOUNDED_HEADER_PREFIX_PLUS_READER_METADATA. No other class mentions a header prefix.
Q4_header_prefix_admission.code_violation: _decode line ~639 calls broker.header_prefix(176 if source_format == 'SAV' else 512) UNCONDITIONALLY for every source and format.
Q4_header_prefix_admission.verified: a plain SAV decode reported header_prefix_reads=1, header_prefix_bytes=176 even though the carrier's class admits no header-prefix operation

answers_to_mission_subquestions.must_SRC02_SRC06_SRC14_have_zero_header_: YES. Their classes (BOUNDED_FRESH_PHYSICAL_SELECTED_VARIABLE_READ / BOUNDED_FRESH_PHYSICAL_READ_EXACT_VARIABLE) admit existence check, hash, metadata and one selected/exact-variable read - no header prefix. Today each performs one.
answers_to_mission_subquestions.is_a_512_byte_DTA_header_operation_froze: NO. The freeze names 176 bytes for SRC26 (SAV). A 512-byte DTA header read is an implementation invention for sources whose operation class does not admit one.

Q5_SRC08_SRC12_metadata_only.answer: YES - their metadata-only declared-encoding admission FORBIDS a compatibility full read

frozen.retry_law: Admitted operation is exact-SHA declared-encoding admission plus a metadata-only reader probe.

Q5_SRC08_SRC12_metadata_only.code_hazard: with no selected set and encoding != None, _decode takes the `elif encoding is not None` branch and calls broker.full_read(encoding=...). SRC08/SRC12 are declared-encoding lanes, so this branch is exactly the one they route into.
Q5_SRC08_SRC12_metadata_only.verified: on a carrier registered as a declared-encoding lane, the decode reported metadata_reads=1 AND full_reads=1
Q5_SRC08_SRC12_metadata_only.is_the_gate_broken: NO - supplying full_reads=0 as the budget DOES refuse with SOURCE_ACCESS_BUDGET_EXCEEDED. The machinery works.
Q5_SRC08_SRC12_metadata_only.the_actual_defect: there is no PER-SOURCE OPERATION PLAN. _decode derives its default budget from the presence of a selected set only (full_reads=0 iff selected_variables is given); it has no notion that a metadata-only source class must forbid a full read. So the frozen expectation is enforceable only if the caller happens to encode it.

Q7_SRC27_one_pass_requirement.answer: it requires exactly ONE FULL READ and exactly ONE DECODER ENTRY (one governed decode of the source's row data), and it does NOT require one reader invocation

layer_by_layer.outer full Route-B pass: exactly 1 (the governed workload pass over 50 candidates / 77 query roles)
layer_by_layer.decoder invocation: exactly 1 - the pass is one governed decode of the source
layer_by_layer.metadata read: at least 1 and SEPARATE - the hardened note requires 'one metadata read' as its own account
layer_by_layer.chunk read: 0 on the SRC27 lane (it is a declared-encoding/full-read lane, not the chunk route)
layer_by_layer.reader invocation: 2 in the verified SRC27-shaped run (metadata + full read); the law does not cap this and MUST NOT be capped at 1, or the metadata read the hardened note requires would become impossible
layer_by_layer.physical path open: 1 under the accepted broker; no authority requires more

Q7_SRC27_one_pass_requirement.why_both_one_full_read_and_one_decoder_e: the frozen text fixes the pass at exactly one (max 1) and separately requires a metadata pass and a full read as distinct accounts; within one decoder entry those are one metadata read plus one full read. One decoder entry therefore implies one full read, and a second full read within the same entry would be a second pass.
Q7_SRC27_one_pass_requirement.do_NOT_conflate: a MAX 1 ceiling must be applied to the DECODER-ENTRY account only. Applying it to reader_invocations would forbid the mandatory metadata read.

Q8_MAX_1_decoder_invocation: see 04_DECODER_INVOCATION_ACCOUNT_REVIEW.json - lawful as a typed AUTHORIZATION ceiling, not as a fabricated historical count
